spec_match.rationale: Uses real iframes with different allow attributes, reads document.featurePolicy for the directive, and reports the deny-frame focusing anyway as a warn state — honest about this build lacking the policy.

interactive.rationale: All three buttons (activation check, allowed-iframe focus, denied-iframe focus) execute real cross-frame focus() calls with live readouts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised with/without-activation focus comparison.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers allowed vs denied frames and missing-UserActivation-API, but not sandbox interaction or header (vs allow-attribute) delivery.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 5 pass / 1 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: exercised all three buttons; deny-frame readout showed 'focus() focused iframe input' rendered in the warn style since this build lacks the directive; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only injected page-level telemetry.js; no per-demo assert telemetry.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, warn/ok colors from the accent palette.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons and stat rows, but focus outcomes update as text without a live region.

openQuestions.title: State the Chromium-141 outcome more loudly
openQuestions.detail: When the deny iframe still gets focus because the directive is absent from this build, the row styling flags it but a one-line explanation ('this browser does not implement the directive yet — Chrome 151+ required') near the result would prevent misreading it as a demo bug.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked activation-check and both iframe focus buttons; the denied frame focused anyway and the page surfaced it as a warn with featurePolicy detection rows explaining the missing directive; zero console errors; panel 5 pass / 1 fail.
